review_candidates.title: Operational Risk Manager – Banking & Financial Services
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in banking operational risk, risk assessment, internal controls, incident management, and regulatory risk management, with a strong understanding of Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) requirements. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and continuously enhance Axis's Operational Risk Management Framework, policies, procedures, and internal controls. Lead Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA) and maintain operational risk registers and mitigation
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in banking operational risk, risk assessment, internal controls, incident management, and regulatory risk management, with a strong understanding of Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) requirements. Ensure operational risk management practices align with applicable Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) regulations and relevant financial services requirements. Qualifications & Requirements Bachelor's degree in Finance, Banking, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Risk Management, or a related field. 7–10+ years of experience in Operational Risk Management, with previous hands-on experience within an Egyptian bank being mandatory. Strong knowledge of CBE regulations, banking operational risk requirements, and financial services risk management practices.
